name: vibesearch-extension
description: A multi purpose tab manager and bookmarks manager and search engine for your browser. Use natural language queries, powerful filters, OCR, screenshots everything offline, in your browser.

scripts.build: bun scripts/ensure-import-media-token.mjs && NODE_ENV=production bunx vite build --config vite.config.chrome.ts
scripts.build:chrome: bun scripts/ensure-import-media-token.mjs && NODE_ENV=production bunx vite build --config vite.config.chrome.ts
scripts.build:firefox: bun scripts/ensure-import-media-token.mjs && NODE_ENV=production bunx vite build --config vite.config.firefox.ts && node scripts/validate-firefox-build.mjs
scripts.dev: bun scripts/ensure-import-media-token.mjs && NODE_ENV=development bunx nodemon --config nodemon.chrome.json
scripts.dev:chrome: bun scripts/ensure-import-media-token.mjs && NODE_ENV=development bunx nodemon --config nodemon.chrome.json
scripts.dev:firefox: bun scripts/ensure-import-media-token.mjs && NODE_ENV=development bunx nodemon --config nodemon.firefox.json
